decisions.reason: Because this finned-tube offer stayed visible beyond launch while several other 2018 launches were withdrawn quickly, and because it fits the firm's established heat-transfer portfolio in a growing, R&D-intensive business, its option value still appears to exceed its likely low carrying cost.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes are closely aligned with the firm's core engineering capabilities and installed-base business, so after surviving the initial screening period they likely remain a low-cost, strategically useful option with better prospects than the products already dropped.
